overview.about: The Maybank Championship is a DP World Tour event played at the Kuala Lumpur Golf and Country Club in the Malaysian capital. A key stop on the European tour's early-season Asian swing, it brings a strong international field to a lush, tropical parkland course in the heart of the city.
overview.nextEvent: The next Maybank Championship is played at Kuala Lumpur Golf and Country Club. Heat, humidity and sudden downpours test the field on the tree-lined city course.
